Lina (partnerships): Hey team — EdgeCo LOI came through. We need to lock redistribution + marketplace packaging and a simple addendum for redistribution licensing. Goal: get artifacts staged and CI-green for a co-announce next week. Thoughts?
Sam (legal): Need to confirm three things up front: 1) redistribution scope (redistribute vs. serve-only), 2) geo-restrictions and export controls, 3) attribution and branding rules. I can draft a short "Marketplace Redistribution Addendum" today.
Raj (product): From product POV: we must support two consumption paths: hosted endpoint (service-hosted) and downloadable bundle (SaaS customers want on-prem). Bundles need manifests and lightweight provenance files.
Maria (solutions): Packaging recommendation: include 1) docker image or runbook, 2) weights tarball, 3) manifest file, 4) provenance.md, 5) sample_prompts.json. Keep manifest minimal so marketplace can validate automatically.
Maria (solutions): example manifest snippet (for CI validation):
```
model_version: 3.1-edgeco-q8
artifact_type: tar.gz
quantization: int8
tokenizer: hf/edgeco-tokenizer
weights_sha256: abcd1234...
```
Sam (legal): That manifest looks fine. I will add fields for declared export classification and a provenance URL. Also adding an explicit clause: partner certifies they have rights to redistribute third-party components (tokenizers, vocab).
EdgeCo (partner): We plan to supply an int8 quantized Llama-3 variant + sample eval set. Request: geoblock for EU and CN for now, and co-brand on the marketplace tile. Is that acceptable?
Sam (legal): Geoblock: acceptable with documented rationale. Co-branding: fine but marketing needs an MOA (memorandum of agreement) and a short approved brand kit. I'll draft placeholders.
Nate (eng-partner): For CI and integration tests: recommend these jobs in orchestrate-lite: 1) smoke generation (10 tokens) across python/cpp runtimes; 2) tokenization parity check; 3) checksum verification for weights. We'll need EdgeCo to provide a presigned S3 upload and a small set of test vectors.
deploy-bot: staging path ready: s3://redwood-partners/edgeco/1767888899/ (presign link will be posted once upload completes).
Lina (partnerships): Proposed timeline: Sam to post addendum draft by Fri EOD; EdgeCo uploads artifacts by Mon noon PT; eng runs CI and resolves blockers Mon-Tue; marketing + partners sign off Tue; embargo lift Wed. Everyone good?
Raj (product): Tight but doable. One more: decide on license type for downloadable bundles. Prefer non-exclusive redistribution with attribution + no re-licensing. Sam, can you add that?
Sam (legal): Yes. Non-exclusive redistribution, no sublicense to redistribute further, attribution required. Also adding indemnity carve-outs and de-listing process.
Maria (solutions): Small ask: include a minimal README with run commands and expected health-check endpoints. CI will look for /health returning 200.
Nate (eng-partner): Will add CI checks for /health and a tokenization parity script. Expected exit codes: 0 for pass, 2 for warn (e.g., minor tokenizer mismatch), 3 for fail. Document in GH.
EdgeCo (partner): We'll prepare docker + tar.gz bundles and include README, manifest, provenance.md, and a 500-sample eval. We'll also include signed provenance metadata. Uploading by Mon.
Lina (partnerships): Action items: Sam: addendum draft; Maria: final manifest spec; Nate + Raj: CI matrix and test vectors; EdgeCo: package + upload. Deadline: Mon 12pm PT for artifacts, Tue noon for CI green.
Sam (legal): Draft will be in redwood/partners/edgeco-onboard by Fri EOD.
Lina (partnerships): Great. Quick sync Mon 9am PT?
EdgeCo (partner): Works for us. Thanks everyone! :raised_hands:
Maria (solutions): I'll add the manifest validator to the GH repo so CI can auto-validate manifest keys.
Nate (eng-partner): Noted. I'll wire orchestrate-lite jobs and post the YAML in the repo.
Lina (partnerships): Thanks team, ping me in this thread if anything deviates from timeline.
